description:
Elijah is the almighty god of plants, but due to false accusation ends up being imprisoned in a cell for 200 years. He seeks escape from reality through the melodrama in novels and suddenly ends up possessing Roselita Derman, a dying marquis. Expecting the life in the novel to be much easier, he was in for a rude awakening. He finds out that Roselita did not commit suicide by drinking poison, and aims to find her name and clear her reputation in the meantime. 

*“Aak! Who are you, really?!”

“Me? I’m the fairy of the mallet who protects love and justice.”

* And he’s going to have a fateful love that he’s only seen in dramas and novels!

*“No one will ever point fingers at you again.”
*
The Derman family, especially her uncle Benjamin, can’t stand it even if I move a finger. Damn it. This is the first time I’ve felt this kind of affection! And to top it all off, the broken-down crown prince is my fiancé…? What about my romance? My fateful love!?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
